ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across ~85% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white/grey) clusters localized on the distal ~15% of each lobe.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal-most regions of both lobes exhibit high-contrast white/grey mottling. The left distal lobe contains approximately 5-6 discrete dark circular spots. The right distal lobe features a contiguous light-grey block transitioning into a series of parallel dark vertical/diagonal bands at the extreme outer margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with an approximate internal angle of 38 degrees and a vertical pixel depth roughly 8% of the visible fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge exhibits high-amplitude, irregular serrations with three primary deep notches located in the distal half. Right lobe trailing edge features higher-frequency, lower-amplitude peaks (approximately 12 distinct points) along the medial-distal boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges follow a general convex curvature from the median notch to the tips, significantly modified by serration. Leading edges (partially visible) show a smooth concave sweep toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of white, circular, high-contrast pixel formations (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme superior-distal tips of both lobes. Several dark circular pits are visible within the white distal pigmentation patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single prominent horizontal white linear abrasion on the mid-left lobe. A highly distinct series of ~9 parallel, diagonal dark rake marks located on the far distal-superior margin of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue-loss notches on the left trailing edge. Extensive parallel rake-mark scarring on the right distal lobe tip. A small, discrete white circular spot is visible on the dark surface approximately 15% left of the median notch.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique and symmetric barnacle clusters on the extreme tips, combined with a distinct 'comb-like' pattern of parallel rake marks on the right lobe distal edge.
